method-development.note: Everything in this pilot is method-development. No outer held-out exists yet; independent generalization claims are NOT_AVAILABLE (SPEC v0.3 §5.1).

innerSplit.rule: Within one PLE, the agent sees the episode's learning history (innerRole=learning_history) and is evaluated on unseen future probes (innerRole=future_probe). This does not violate the outer split.

leakageGroups.rule: History from this leakage group may enter actor input ONLY for runs of this same episode's probes. A fixture from any other leakage group must be rejected at actor-input assembly.
